item.description:
Bernstein, F., Modaresi, S., Saure, D.
We study dynamic assortment personalization, where an online retailer adaptively selects assortments based on customer attributes to learn preferences and maximize revenue. We assume that product utilities depend linearly on customer attributes through an unknown coefficient matrix, leading to an exploration–exploitation trade-off. item.title: jsN: JavaScript Tools for Sample Size Calculation in Clinical Studies
item.description:
Kengo Nagashima
jsN is a JavaScript library and a collection of 40 web applications for sample size and power calculation in clinical and medical research. All calculations run in the web browser; no data are sent to a server. It covers continuous, binary and time-to-event outcomes, non-inferiority designs, mixed models for repeated measures, Simon's two-stage design and the randomized phase II selection design.
